name: H-ATLAS J091043.1-000321 (Hubble)
blurb: H-ATLAS J091043.1-000321, a gravitationally lensed dusty galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: sdss091043000323-hubble
story: Here an elliptical or lenticular galaxy in the foreground bends the light of a dust-shrouded galaxy far behind it, one of the first gravitational lenses found by the Herschel ATLAS survey. The hidden galaxy is caught in a fierce burst of star formation, and Hubble's sharp view helps astronomers reconstruct its true shape.
